title: Route 9 Small Bay BOV
summary: Fictional Industrial Advisors values Route 9 Small Bay at $12,900,000–$13,700,000, most likely $13,280,000, and recommends listing at $13,700,000.

evidence.quote: Prepared by Fictional Industrial Advisors for Model Fund I — Valley Freight LLC.
This opinion of value is dated November 2, 2026.
We estimate the market value of Route 9 Small Bay at between $12,900,000 and $13,700,000.
We estimate the market value of Route 9 Small Bay at between $12,900,000 and $13,700,000.
That value is $316 per square foot.
